articles.title: France's parliament approves vote to hit stablecoin trades with 31% capital gains tax
articles.snippet: Amendment I-3898 removes tax deferral for MiCA-compliant stablecoins starting January 2027.

articles.title: Tether: Senator's investigation misses positive work that's led to lower Iran volumes
articles.snippet: The stablecoin issuer's CEO, Paolo Ardoino, has been defending against accusations that the firm's stablecoins have fueled financial activity in Iran.

articles.title: Injective, BDACS plan Korean won stablecoin settlement for tokenized assets
articles.snippet: Injective and BDACS plan to bring won-backed stablecoin KRW1 to tokenized asset markets as South Korea develops a regulatory framework for local currency stablecoins.

articles.title: Stablecoin transfers quadruple to $891B as US banks expand adoption: Report
articles.snippet: Coinbase reports growing adoption by banks and businesses, even as stablecoin market capitalization remains largely unchanged over the past year.

articles.title: Tx launches USTX stablecoin to pull RWA liquidity onto its chain
articles.snippet: The Brale-issued token can be minted with USDC from eight networks and is designed to settle tokenized stocks and other assets on tx.
